description: Reseller and federal orders received in the ERP from the portal, API, EDI, and sales staff; credit checks; allocation; order confirmations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $3.28 million revenue and 9,800 order lines per shipping day; resellers buy elsewhere when orders miss the same-day cutoff; 12 hours is one shipping day
manual_workaround: Portal and API keep accepting orders into a queue; sales staff take orders on the order form template and key them after recovery; credit holds released by the Credit Manager from the last aging report
quantified_operational_impact: About 9,800 order lines per day; about 1,960 sales-entered lines stop at once; each hour down delays about 820 lines
quantified_regulatory_impact: None directly; federal orders keep their contract delivery dates

business_process: Reseller portal and order API (Partner Commerce Platform)
description: Self-service catalog, contract pricing, ordering, order status, and invoices for about 9,600 reseller users; API ordering for 60 large resellers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 55% of order lines (about $1.80 million a day); 3 national resellers require availability evidence (P09); portal vendor commitments RTO 4 hours, RPO 1 hour
manual_workaround: Resellers email orders to inside sales or send EDI; customer service posts status updates on the portal banner
dependent_third_parties: Portal vendor; hosted payment page provider
quantified_operational_impact: About 5,400 order lines per day; 60 API resellers cannot submit automatically
quantified_regulatory_impact: Contract availability commitments to 3 national resellers

business_process: EDI order, ship notice, and invoice exchange
description: Purchase orders, advance ship notices, and invoices with 140 trading partners, including federal channel purchase orders
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 25% of order lines (about $820,000 a day); large resellers charge back late ship notices; federal channel purchase orders arrive by EDI
manual_workaround: Trading partners send purchase orders by secure email; ship notices sent in a batch after recovery
quantified_operational_impact: About 2,450 order lines per day; ship notices for about 900 shipments delayed
quantified_regulatory_impact: Federal channel purchase orders (FCI) must stay in approved systems during the workaround

description: Pick, pack, and ship about 80% of units from DC-1 with the WMS, 330 RF handhelds, conveyor, sortation, and vertical lift storage
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $2.62 million of shipments a day; carrier pickups close each afternoon; federal channel delivery dates; worker safety on the conveyor during manual operation
manual_workaround: Manual pick mode from paper pick lists printed from the WMS standby (about 40% of normal capacity); sortation bypassed to manual lanes; priority to federal and next-day orders
dependent_third_parties: DC automation integrator; ISPs; SD-WAN provider
quantified_operational_impact: About 2,900 shipments per day; manual mode ships about 1,150
quantified_regulatory_impact: Federal channel delivery dates in subcontract purchase orders

description: Overflow fulfillment, cross-dock, returns authorization and processing, and OEM warranty returns
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $660,000 of shipments a day; return windows are measured in weeks
manual_workaround: Ship overflow orders from DC-1 stock; hold returns on the dock with paper receipts
quantified_operational_impact: About 700 shipments and 250 returns per day

description: Carrier rating, tendering, labels, and tracking for all shipments
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Every shipment needs a label before carrier cutoff; one TMS for all carriers
manual_workaround: Carrier web portals for labels at about 30% of normal throughput; prioritize federal and next-day shipments
dependent_third_parties: TMS vendor; parcel and LTL carriers
dependent_people_or_facilities: Shipping teams at DC-1 and DC-2
quantified_operational_impact: About 3,600 shipments per day; portal workaround labels about 1,100

business_process: Receiving, authenticity inspection, and inventory control
description: Receive inbound shipments; check quantities, serial numbers, seals, and authenticity; quarantine suspect items; cycle counts
process_owner: Director of Quality and Product Compliance
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Inbound trucks can be held for about 2 days; authenticity inspection is where counterfeit and tampered products are stopped (P08)
manual_workaround: Hold inbound trucks; receive authorized-source stock on paper; keep all broker and private-label receipts in quarantine until systems return
dependent_people_or_facilities: Receiving and quality staff at DC-1 and DC-2
quantified_operational_impact: About 180 inbound receipts per day; detention fees about $12,000 a day
quantified_regulatory_impact: DFARS 252.246-7008 and 252.246-7007 inspection records for parts bound for DoD jobs

description: Purchase orders to 251 suppliers; approved supplier list; forecasting and automated reordering (AI-001)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Fast-moving SKUs hold 5 to 10 days of cover; federal orders must use authorized sources
manual_workaround: Buyers place priority orders by phone and supplier portals from the last ERP reorder report; no broker purchases during an outage
quantified_operational_impact: About 1,200 purchase order lines per day
quantified_regulatory_impact: DFARS 252.246-7008 sourcing order applies to DoD job stock

business_process: Integration Center (commercial configuration, imaging, and kitting)
description: Stage, image, tag, and kit equipment for commercial reseller projects
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $160,000 of services and attached product a day; project dates set by resellers
manual_workaround: Defer jobs; ship unconfigured equipment where the reseller agrees
dependent_systems: SYS-02; SYS-08 (file services, image repository); SYS-11

business_process: Federal Integration Lab (CUI configuration and staging)
description: Configure and stage network, video, and server equipment for DoD installations under Prime A, B, and C subcontracts using CUI configuration documents
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $232,000 of revenue a day; prime schedules allow several days; CUI may be restored only into the enclave
manual_workaround: No workaround outside the enclave: CUI may never be moved to corporate systems, personal devices, or paper outside the FIL. Jobs pause and primes are told of new dates
dependent_systems: SYS-09; SYS-10 (FIL network); SYS-11 (FIL workstations); SYS-13 (FIL cage)
dependent_third_parties: Government community cloud provider; Prime A, B, C
quantified_operational_impact: About 45 jobs a month; a 72-hour stop delays about 6 jobs
quantified_regulatory_impact: DFARS 252.204-7012 safeguarding and CMMC scope rules apply during recovery; misconfigured equipment could reach a DoD network

business_process: Government contract compliance and incident reporting
description: SPRS entries; CMMC affirmations; Section 889 and FASCSA screening and reports; DIBNet cyber incident reports; notices to primes and contracting officers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: DFARS 252.204-7012(c) report within 72 hours of discovery; FAR 52.204-25(d) report within 1 business day; FAR 52.204-30(c) report within 3 business days; an outage caused by an incident starts these clocks
manual_workaround: DIBNet reached from a clean device with the medium assurance certificate; contact lists printed in the incident binder
dependent_people_or_facilities: Director of Federal Programs; Contracts Compliance Manager
quantified_operational_impact: A handful of reports a year, but each has a fixed clock
quantified_regulatory_impact: Missed 72-hour, 1-business-day, or 3-business-day reports breach the subcontracts and risk the federal channel ($148 million a year)

business_process: Credit, billing, collections, and cash application
description: Invoicing, credit limits, collections, and cash application for about 4,200 accounts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $3.28 million invoiced a day; cash delay drives revolving credit line interest
manual_workaround: Invoice from ERP extracts after recovery; credit decisions from the last aging report
quantified_operational_impact: About $9.8 million of invoicing delayed over 72 hours

description: Supplier payments; supplier master data; bank-detail changes with call-back verification
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Supplier terms tolerate a few days; bank-detail changes are a fraud target (near miss 2026-02)
manual_workaround: Pay critical suppliers through the bank portal from the approved payment file; no bank-detail changes during an outage
quantified_operational_impact: About $3 million of supplier payments a day; early-payment discounts lost

description: Order status, returns authorization, product and compatibility questions, and the portal chatbot (AI-003)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Resellers expect same-day answers; the portal chatbot handles about 30% of status questions
manual_workaround: Phone and email answers from ERP read-only views; status posted on the portal banner

business_process: Import and customs filing for private-label accessories
description: Purchase orders to 6 overseas contract manufacturers; entry filing by the licensed customs broker; inbound container tracking
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 3 containers a week; demurrage after free time at the port
manual_workaround: Customs broker files from emailed commercial invoices and packing lists
quantified_operational_impact: About 3 containers a week; demurrage about $5,000 a day after free time
quantified_regulatory_impact: Entry filing deadlines are met by the customs broker

description: Time capture, payroll, onboarding and terminations, and warehouse hiring (AI-005 screening)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Weekly payroll for hourly warehouse staff; missed payroll has legal and retention impact
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior payroll through the payroll provider; paper time sheets
dependent_systems: Payroll SaaS; applicant tracking system; SYS-06
quantified_regulatory_impact: State wage payment rules if payroll is late

description: Data warehouse, margin and inventory reporting, and AI-001 training data
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Reports can be rebuilt from ERP extracts
quantified_operational_impact: Weekly margin and inventory reports delayed
